headline: Egypt seeks fate of 27 nationals after migrant boat sinks off Libya
label: NEWS
caption:
Families are anxiously waiting for answers as authorities work to trace missing citizens. 🌊

According to Middle East Monitor, Egypt is actively seeking the fate of 27 of its nationals following the sinking of a migrant boat off the coast of Libya.

Rescue and diplomatic efforts are underway to gather information regarding the victims and survivors of the maritime tragedy.

Authorities have not yet released further details on potential survivors or the exact timeline of the sinking.
